questions.question: Tattvabodhini Patrika promoted the study of India’s past in which language?
questions.solution: The Tattvabodhini Patrika, started by Debendranath Tagore, promoted the study of India's past and religious reform primarily in Bengali.

questions.question: Devanampriya Piyadasi is another name for whom among the following Mauryan kings?
questions.solution: Ashoka is frequently referred to in his inscriptions by the titles Devanampriya (Beloved of the Gods) and Piyadasi (Of Pleasing Appearance).

questions.question: Ashoka sent his son Mahendra and daughter Sanghmitra to spread the message of Dhamma to which of the following countries?
questions.solution: Emperor Ashoka sent his son Mahendra and daughter Sanghmitra to Sri Lanka to propagate Buddhism.

questions.question: Which of the following leaders had gone to Lucknow to invite Mahatma Gandhi to see the plight of the peasants in Champaran?
questions.solution: Raj Kumar Shukla, a local farmer, met Gandhi at the 1916 Lucknow session to invite him to investigate the Indigo planters' plight in Champaran.
